mo_ta_cong_viec:
Are you an experienced Project Leader/ Project Manager (Japanese N2+) with a strong background in IT and software delivery for the Japanese market? We are seeking a proactive and results-driven leader to manage complex projects, ensure high-quality outcomes, and collaborate effectively with both internal teams and Japanese clients.
 
Plan and lead implementation projects of varying size and complexity
Manage project teams, including task assignment, progress tracking, and quality assurance
Estimate workload, develop work plans, and oversee delivery within scope, budget, and timeline
Ensure accurate project reporting, including risk and change management, and financial control
Build and manage team members, including training, development, and career path planning
Lead and execute tasks to ensure project success across quality, cost, and schedule
Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders and external clients
Perform other tasks as assigned by the Manager or Senior Manager.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field 
Over 7 years of experience in software development, including at least 2 years as Project Manager/ Team Leader/ BrSE for the Japanese market.
Proven experience managing teams of at least 5 members 
Strong skills in project estimation, quality control, resource management, and risk management 
Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile/Scrum 
Experience in developing and deploying web-based software projects using Java Spring Framework or C# ASP.NET, especially in domains such as Insurance, Healthcare solutions, is an advantage.
Possession of PMP/ACP certification 
Proficiency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or higher) 
Strong leadership, problem-solving, and team management skills 
Ability to work and negotiate directly with Japanese clients 
Strong presentation and client relationship skills.
